vulnerabilities.title: Hardcoded API Key
vulnerabilities.description: API key is hardcoded in source code, making it visible to anyone with access to the codebase
vulnerabilities.impact: Unauthorized access to AWS services, potential data breach
vulnerabilities.fix_applied: Moved API key to environment variable with proper fallback handling

vulnerabilities.title: SQL Injection
vulnerabilities.vulnerable_code: sql = "SELECT id, username FROM users WHERE username LIKE '%{}%'".format(name)
vulnerabilities.description: Direct string formatting in SQL query allows attackers to inject malicious SQL code
vulnerabilities.impact: Full database compromise, data theft, data manipulation
vulnerabilities.fix_applied: Implemented parameterized queries using SQLite parameter binding
vulnerabilities.secure_code:
sql = "SELECT id, username FROM users WHERE username LIKE ?"
cur.execute(sql, (f'%{name}%',))

vulnerabilities.title: Insecure Deserialization (Pickle)
vulnerabilities.description: Direct pickle deserialization of user input allows remote code execution
vulnerabilities.impact: Complete system compromise, arbitrary code execution
vulnerabilities.fix_applied: Replaced pickle with JSON deserialization and added input validation
vulnerabilities.secure_code:
profile = request.get_json()
# Added validation and sanitization

vulnerabilities.title: Command Injection
vulnerabilities.description: Direct concatenation of user input into system command allows command injection
vulnerabilities.impact: Full system compromise, arbitrary command execution
vulnerabilities.fix_applied: Implemented command whitelisting and removed system command execution
vulnerabilities.secure_code:
allowed_commands = ['help', 'status', 'version']
# Predefined responses instead of system execution

vulnerabilities.title: Server-Side Template Injection
vulnerabilities.description: User input directly inserted into template without escaping enables template injection
vulnerabilities.impact: Code execution, information disclosure, template engine compromise
vulnerabilities.fix_applied: Added input validation and proper escaping using Flask's escape function

vulnerabilities.title: Weak Authentication
vulnerabilities.description: Hardcoded passwords stored in plaintext with weak authentication logic
vulnerabilities.fix_applied: Implemented proper password hashing with Werkzeug and database storage

vulnerabilities.title: Debug Mode Enabled
vulnerabilities.description: Debug mode enabled exposes sensitive application information and stack traces
vulnerabilities.impact: Information disclosure, easier exploitation of other vulnerabilities
vulnerabilities.fix_applied: Made debug mode configurable via environment variable, disabled by default

hardcoded_secrets.fix: Replaced with hashed password in database

additional_security_improvements.description: Added proper database schema initialization with secure user storage
additional_security_improvements.implementation: init_db() function creates users table with hashed passwords

additional_security_improvements.description: Added proper error handlers to prevent information leakage
additional_security_improvements.implementation: Custom 404 and 500 error handlers with generic messages

additional_security_improvements.description: Added comprehensive input validation and length limits
additional_security_improvements.implementation: Validation for all user inputs with appropriate limits
Error logging for security events and failed operations

additional_security_improvements.description: Made application configurable via environment variables
additional_security_improvements.implementation: Host, port, debug mode, and secrets configurable via environment
